en.description: How to play PPPoker from Armenia: download the app, join NUTS club (ID 111777), deposit and withdraw. Russian and Armenian support.
en.bodyHtml:
Author: Garik Avetisyan, Head of Loyalty at NUTS (Yerevan)

Published: June 2027

From Yerevan, I know the Armenian poker community better than my CRM. Same questions every time: does PPPoker work in Armenia, how to deposit, is there rakeback. Short answers — club NUTS (ID 111777), USD account, deposits from $10.

PPPoker in Armenia

The app works for players in Yerevan, Gyumri, Vanadzor and across the country. Download from App Store, Google Play or the PPPoker site. VPN is usually not required.

Currency and limits

  • Account — USD
  • Minimum deposit — from $10
  • Cash — from NL2, around the clock
  • Tournaments — from $0.50, weekly GTD

AMD deposits via manager at the current rate. Deposits and withdrawals.

Getting started

  1. Download PPPoker
  2. Enter club ID 111777
  3. Message @NUTSsup
  4. Deposit via @NUTS111777_bot

Join in 5 minutes

Blog and guides in Armenian: pppoker.pro/hy/. RSS: /hy/feed.xml.
